title: MrJ-LayoutFX — I²C known-device table
description: Lookup table served by /api/i2c-known. Maps I²C device addresses (decimal string) to chip names shown in the I²C scanner results.

^([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-1][0-9]|12[0-7])$.description: Chip name or slash-separated alternatives (e.g. 'SSD1306/SH1106'). Key is the 7-bit I²C address in decimal (0-127).
